name: Captions model
why: About 140 MB, one-time download. Times the on-screen words to the voice. Runs on this computer. Videos never download it themselves.

install: d="$(mktemp -d)" && ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=16000:cl=mono -t 2 "$d/silence.wav" && (cd "$d" && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes transcribe silence.wav --model base.en --language en >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf "$d"; true)
